blocks.en:
In this section we state a collection of results that allow us to solve the Riemann problem for systems of equations, but some of our proofs are only for the special case of the $p$ system. This allows us to keep our treatment fairly brief and concrete while displaying most of the ideas involved in the more general proofs.

For the single conservation law we were able to connect any pair of left and right states using a single wave, either a shock or a rarefaction wave. In higher dimensions, we will have to use intermediate states and several different waves to make the connection. However, as a first step, we will see what left and right states can be "hooked up" using a single shock or rarefaction wave.
blocks.zh:
本节陈述一组能够求解方程组 Riemann 问题的结果, 但其中一些证明只针对 $p$ 方程组这个特殊情形. 这样, 既能使论述相当简短而具体, 又能展示更一般证明中涉及的大部分思想.

对单个守恒律, 可以用单个波, 即激波或稀疏波, 连接任意一对左状态与右状态. 在更高维情形下, 必须使用中间状态和几个不同的波来连接. 不过, 作为第一步, 先考察哪些左状态与右状态可以用单个激波或稀疏波"连接起来".

blocks.en: We begin by considering the possibility of using a single shock wave to connect the left and right states. Thus, we have to ask the question: given $\bm{u}^l$, what states $\bm{u}^r$ satisfy the Rankine-Hugoniot condition \eqref{eq:rankine-hugoniot-jump-condition} and the Lax shock condition \eqref{eq:lax-shock-condition}? The answer is that, emanating from each point $\bm{u}^l$ in state space, there are $n$ \emph{shock curves} that describe the possible right states that can be connected by a single shock. More specifically, we have the following theorem.
blocks.zh: 首先考虑用单个激波连接左状态与右状态的可能性. 因此需要问: 给定 $\bm{u}^l$, 哪些状态 $\bm{u}^r$ 满足 Rankine-Hugoniot 条件 \eqref{eq:rankine-hugoniot-jump-condition} 和 Lax 激波条件 \eqref{eq:lax-shock-condition}? 答案是, 从状态空间中的每个点 $\bm{u}^l$ 出发, 存在 $n$ 条\emph{激波曲线}, 描述可由单个激波连接的所有可能的右状态. 更具体地说, 有以下定理.

blocks.en: Pictorially, we see that emanating from each left state $\bm{u}^l$ we have the two shock curves $S_1$ and $S_2$. Shocks with negative speed (sometimes called slow shocks or back-shocks) lie along $S_1$; shocks with positive speed (fast shocks or front-shocks) lie along $S_2$.
blocks.zh: 从图上可见, 每个左状态 $\bm{u}^l$ 都发出两条激波曲线 $S_1$ 和 $S_2$. 负速度的激波 (有时称为慢激波或后向激波) 位于 $S_1$ 上; 正速度的激波 (快激波或前向激波) 位于 $S_2$ 上.
